headline: Standard Chartered Kenya 9M Pre-Tax Profit Increases 13% to KES 14.9 Billion
summary: Standard Chartered Bank Kenya recorded a 13% year-on-year increase in pre-tax profit to 14.9 billion Kenyan shillings for the first nine months of 2026.
why: Standard Chartered Kenya is a prominent commercial bank listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange.
